analysis.reasonEn: RSI declined from 61.8 to 59.0, entering neutral territory. MACD histogram improved from 3.1990 to 4.2655, continuing bullish expansion. Volume ratio at 0.30 of 5-day average indicates subdued activity, suggesting a lack of directional conviction. The 52-week position at 63.6% also points to a neutral range. As a 15-year swing trader, the current phase lacks clear direction, making a wait-and-see approach prudent.
